item.title: Bunnie Xo Memoir Returns to Bestsellers Charts on Heels of Jelly Roll Split
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and trends. Today, we're talking about Bunnie Xo's memoir, "Stripped Down: Unfiltered and Unapologetic", which has just returned to the top of the charts on Amazon's entertainment biographies list.
[Soft music continues in the background]
Host: For those who may not know, Bunnie Xo is a popular influencer who has been making headlines recently due to her split from husband Jelly Roll. Her memoir, released on February 17th, has been a bestseller, thanks to its raw and revealing anecdotes about her life, including her work in the sex industry and her marriage.
[Music transitions to a slightly more upbeat tone]
Host: The book is described as a "modern-day rags-to-riches story" and has been praised for its wit and intensity. Bunnie has said that the book is the "rawest reflection of who I am in every form" and that she wanted to share her journey of redemption with her readers.
[Music softens again]
Host: The memoir's cover is a reflection of Bunnie's time in the sex-work industry, and she has spoken about how that experience helped her reclaim her power after struggling with addiction and abuse as a teenager. Today, she has built a successful empire around Dumb Blonde Productions, including a popular podcast with thousands of monthly listeners.
[Music transitions to a promotional tone]
Host: If you're interested in checking out Bunnie's memoir, you can currently get the audiobook version for just $0.99, which includes three months of access to audiobook streamer Audible. And if you're curious about Bunnie's relationship with Jelly Roll, the two met in Las Vegas in 2015 and got married a year later. Jelly Roll has even written songs about their relationship, including "Hey Mama" and "Kill a Man".
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one!
